name: Krang Blade (CR 5)
body:
Krang Blade
CR 5

XP 1,600
Male krang brawler 4
LN Medium humanoid (krang)
Init +4; Senses Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+4 armor, +1 dodge, +2 natural)
hp 60 (7 HD; 3d8+4d10+25)
Fort +10, Ref +5, Will +1; +2 vs. fear, +4 vs. disease and poison

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.; climb 20 ft.
Melee +1 nine-ring broadsword +12/+7 (1d8+6/x3) or unarmed strike +12/+7 (1d8+5) or flurry of blows +11/+11/+6 (1d8+5), head-butt +6 (1d4+2)
Ranged pepperbox pistol +6/+1 (1d8/x4)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (with melee weapon or unarmed strike)
Special Attacks brawler’s flurry, knockout 1/day (DC 17), maneuver training (bull rush +1), martial flexibility 5/day, relentless, smash (DC 14)

TACTICS

Before Combat A krang blade leads off combat by headbutting a worthy opponent to reduce its effectiveness. Thereafter, he uses Power Attack to land crushing blows with his nine-ring broadsword or a flurry of blows to fend off multiple attackers.

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 11, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 8, Cha 13
Base Atk +6; CMB +11 (+16 bull rush); CMD 22 (25 vs. bull rush)
Feats Greater Bull Rush, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Martial Weapon ProficiencyB (nine-ring broadsword), Power Attack, Weapon Focus (unarmed strike).

Skills Acrobatics +5, Climb +15, Intimidate +11, Knowledge (engineering) +8, Perception +9, Survival +5
Languages Common, Elali, Krang
SQ brawler’s cunning, combat training, elongated arms, martial training
Combat Gear potion of bull’s strength, potion of cure moderate wounds; Other Gear light trooper armor, +1 nine-ring broadsword, amulet of mighty fists +1, pepperbox pistol with 12 metal cartridges.
